def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster selected by the shorter grid side; use its consistent DRAM model.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0

    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time

    # In cache-pressured, sufficiently large-output shapes, reuse distance
    # modifies the traffic outcome rather than acting as a global penalty.
    if p.l2_working_set_pressure > 0.5 and p.output_work_per_sm > 10000.0:
        s = s + w[3] * np.log2(1.0 + d * (1.0 + np.clip(f.swizzle_panel_reuse_distance / hw.l2_bytes, 0.0, 1.0)))

    # The instruction proxy is retained only where traversal traffic is
    # effectively cache-equivalent.
    tie_confidence = np.clip(1.0 - f.swizzle_panel_reuse_distance / hw.l2_bytes, 0.0, 1.0)
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst * tie_confidence
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster the tie-break below realises (current contract cannot see swizzle): along the shorter grid side.
    # M<=N: identity (M-fastest), A panels are the fast-dim panels; M>N: horizontal (N-fastest), B panels are.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0
    # DRAM leg: ONE consistent byte count for that raster (pool feature dram_w1_*): panels fetched once per one-CTA-per-SM
    # K-lockstep window (whole grid if co-resident in one round), re-fetched across windows unless the reuse distance fits L2,
    # plus C write, split-K partials, spills; DRAM time / ideal compute time. Replaces J1e's tm_dram_ratio + ref/rbs double count.
    # SM roof as in J1e: the L2->SM feed (priced at DRAM bandwidth, kappa at its physical bound 1) overlaps the math of the
    # same SM, so the SM runs at the slower of the two; DRAM keeps the imperfect-overlap p=2 combination.
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Efficiency the norm cannot see: register-staged 2-stage mainloop, CTA-wide barrier over more warps.
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    # Split-K time model with an interior optimum, in log2 time.
    s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    # Pure tie-break among raster variants that differ only in inst_total: sign fixed by physics (shorter-side raster),
    # scale fixed at P1's prior 1e-3 per log2(inst) (<< one score unit = 0.1 log2 time), so it is not a fitted feature.
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Width-1 raster the tie-break below realises (current contract cannot see swizzle): along the shorter grid side.
    # M<=N: identity (M-fastest), A panels are the fast-dim panels; M>N: horizontal (N-fastest), B panels are.
    if p.M > p.N:
        d = f.dram_w1_hz_ratio
        sgn = 1.0
    else:
        d = f.dram_w1_id_ratio
        sgn = -1.0
    # DRAM leg: ONE consistent byte count for that raster, including panel reuse, C output, split-K partials, and spills.
    # The SM roof uses the slower of the compute critical path and L2-to-SM feed; DRAM combines imperfectly with it.
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(d))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    # Efficiency the norm cannot see: register-staged 2-stage mainloop, CTA-wide barrier over more warps.
    s = s + w[0] * f.tm_regstaged + w[1] * f.tm_cta_warps
    # Split-K time model with an interior optimum, in log2 time.
    s = s + w[2] * f.splitk_roofline_log_time
    # Under high L2 pressure and enough output work, panel reuse is exposed; use the registered
    # swizzle locality cost only in that regime so it breaks swizzle near-ties without replacing the raster DRAM model.
    swizzle_gate = (p.l2_working_set_pressure > 0.5) & (p.output_work_per_sm > 1024.0)
    s = s + w[3] * np.where(swizzle_gate, np.log2(f.swizzle_panel_locality_cost), 0.0)
    # Pure tie-break among raster variants that differ only in inst_total: sign fixed by physics (shorter-side raster).
    s = s + 0.001 * sgn * f.tm_log_inst
    return s
